description_en: Queries the default log field configuration of a user
description_zh: 查询用户默认日志字段配置
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-user-log-field-config --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-000000 --delivery-type sls --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aek24000000 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUserLogFieldConfig

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The delivery type. Valid values:

sls: Simple Log Service
parameters.help_zh:
投递类型。取值：

sls： 阿里云日志服务
parameters.name: delivery_type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
